subject: Request: staggered keepalive / demo seat while PO in flight
messages:
From: Dana Li <dana@clearmed.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo access timing — procurement update

Hi Avery,

Quick update from procurement: the PO is being routed but it's likely to clear in ~10–12 business days due to an internal audit. The pilot team still needs the environment to finish integration tests — otherwise we risk losing momentum.

Is there any way Redwood can keep one active demo seat and a small token allowance for the core integration team for two weeks until the PO hits? We can share the signed PO as soon as approvals are done; attached is the PO draft procurement asked us to prepare.

Appreciate any help — we really want to keep the pilot progressing.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Li
Director, Integrations
ClearMed Health
Attachment: PO_draft_ClearMed_20260316.pdf
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Li <dana@clearmed.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Demo access timing — procurement update (internal request)

Marissa / Sean / Lauren — Dana from ClearMed says their PO is in flight but will take ~10–12 business days. They asked for one active demo seat + small token allowance for the integration team to keep the pilot going.

Proposed options for approval (pick one):
- Option A (preferred): 14-day no-charge keepalive: 1 seat + 150k tokens total, billing hold until DocuSign PO received.
- Option B: 7-day no-charge keepalive + $500 temporary credit (if finance prefers limited exposure).

Notes: deal id D-78431 in HubSpot. If approved I will: (1) update HubSpot, (2) enable seat & token top-up, (3) send DocuSign link for the PO confirmation. Attach SOW for reference.

Attachments: SOW_Redwood_ClearMed_v1.pdf, PO_draft_ClearMed_20260316.pdf

Avery
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Dana Li <dana@clearmed.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Demo access timing — procurement update (internal request)

Thanks for the context, Avery. Approve Option A for customer success continuity with the following firm conditions:
- 14 calendar days starting when we enable access.
- Limit usage to the integration team: cap tokens to 150k across the period and restrict to 1 seat.
- Require the signed PO via DocuSign before the end of the 14-day window — if PO not received, we revert access and bill for any overages at list price.

Lauren — please record the access change in the rollout log and tag the account. Sean — finance signoff needed to apply the credit + put a temporary billing hold.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_Redwood_ClearMed_v1.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Dana Li <dana@clearmed.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Demo access timing — procurement update (finance)

Finance will approve a one-time interim goodwill credit to keep the pilot alive under these conditions:
- Apply $1,200 credit to account ClearMed (deal D-78431) and flag billing as "pending PO".
- Access enabled for 14 days with a token cap of 150,000. Engineering must enforce the cap; operations will collect usage logs.
- Sales must upload the signed PO to DocuSign link and update HubSpot with the PO number before the 14-day expiry. If PO not uploaded by expiry, we will close the credit and retroactively invoice any usage beyond allowed tokens.

Links:
- HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/78431
- DocuSign (PO template): https://docusign.net/Signing/?s=abc123-clearmed-po

Sean Gallagher
Director, Finance Operations
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Li <dana@clearmed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo access timing — procurement update

Hi Dana — good news. We can enable a temporary keepalive under the plan Marissa and Sean approved:

Summary of what we're enabling:
- 14-day demo seat & environment starting today (expires 2026-03-31).
- 150,000 token cap for the window.
- One-time $1,200 credit applied and account set to billing = "pending PO".
- Condition: upload signed PO to the DocuSign link before 2026-03-31.

Action items for ClearMed:
- Please review and sign the PO here: https://docusign.net/Signing/?s=abc123-clearmed-po
- Confirm the primary integration contact who will use the seat (email).

We attached the SOW and the PO draft again for convenience. If anything changes on your end, ping me and we'll adjust. Looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0172
Attachment: SOW_Redwood_ClearMed_v1.pdf, PO_draft_ClearMed_20260316.pdf
